Control Objective: Ensure revenue transactions are complete and accurate
Control Description: Invoice details are reviewed against the sales register before revenue recognition
Testing Logic: Compare invoice number date customer guest taxable value taxes and total to source evidence

Risk: Cash receipts may not be completely or accurately recorded
Control Objective: Ensure receipts are valid and completely recorded
Control Description: Recorded receipts are reconciled to payment register and bank credits
Testing Logic: Match payment amount reference and date to bank statement evidence

Risk: Exceptions may not be investigated and resolved
Control Objective: Ensure identified exceptions are documented and resolved
Control Description: Exceptions are reviewed by the auditor and conclusion is retained
Testing Logic: Verify exception status auditor comment and conclusion are recorded
